name: New Zealand

meta.title: Study in New Zealand from India: fees, living costs, post-study work
meta.description: New Zealand tuition ranges and the NZ$20,000 living cost rule in rupees, February and July intakes, 25 hours of work a week, and the Post Study Work Visa of up to 3 years.

summary: Published fee ranges, a NZ$20,000 living cost rule, and up to 3 years of post-study work.

whyReasons.text: After a degree at level 7 or higher, studied full-time in New Zealand for at least 30 weeks, you can apply for a Post Study Work Visa of up to 3 years.
PhD students pay the same fees as New Zealand students, about NZ$6,500 to NZ$7,500 a year for most subjects.
Most student visas let you work up to 25 hours a week, and full-time in the holidays.

ug.note: Medicine and veterinary science cost more. Figures updated March 2025.

pg.note: Medicine and veterinary science cost more.

living.note: Estimates published by Victoria University of Wellington, the University of Auckland and the University of Otago. For the visa you must show at least NZ$20,000 for the first year.

visaFunds.text: Show at least NZ$20,000 for each year of tertiary study (or NZ$1,667 a month for courses under a year), in addition to tuition fees.

duringStudy.text: Most student visas allow up to 25 hours of work a week, and full-time work in the holidays.

afterStudy.text: Post Study Work Visa: up to 3 years depending on what you studied. You need a degree at level 7 or higher (or an eligible non-degree qualification), studied full-time in New Zealand for at least 30 weeks.

faq.q: How much money do I need for a New Zealand student visa?
faq.a: At least NZ$20,000 for each year of study for living costs, plus your tuition fees.

faq.q: What does a master's in New Zealand cost?
faq.a: Postgraduate fees range from about NZ$20,000 to NZ$45,000 a year. Medicine and veterinary science cost more.

faq.q: Can I work after studying in New Zealand?
faq.a: Yes. With a degree at level 7 or higher, studied full-time in New Zealand for at least 30 weeks, you can apply for a Post Study Work Visa of up to 3 years.

faq.q: Can my family come with me?
faq.a: It depends on your course and visa. Our video on New Zealand dependent visa rules explains the options, and your counsellor will check your case.
